ability.name: Git and Run
ability.effect: If you picked a target, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat range of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Gitmob^^** unit that is in combat to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with that **^^Gitmob^^** unit to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per phase.
